title: Co-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems for Self-Evolution in LLM-Based Agents

defines.name: CoMAS
defines.definition: A framework that enables LLM-based agents to improve autonomously by learning from inter-agent interactions without external supervision.

problem: Existing RL-based self-evolution methods rely on external supervision or individual self-reward signals, which do not capture human-like collective learning through inter-agent interaction.
